about: The one live action: open an empty folder as the project (the page's URL carries ?cwd=<the folder>; typing a path in the bottom bar went with the bar, 2026-11-13), start one agent from its + plinth with a one-word request, watch its column appear and its context readout change when the token reading arrives. Costs one short Codex turn. Run with --var folder=/absolute/path/to/an/empty/folder (with a README.md in it).

actions.note: guard: the floor is the empty test folder

actions.type: Reply with the single word ok and do nothing else.

actions.log: the readout above the column changes when Codex's token reading (thread/tokenUsage/updated) arrives: shots every 3 s

actions.note: at least one token reading arrived; the methods seen and the readings are in run.json's final state
not column:$c.id: Codex retitles a new session after its first message, and a column's name is its title
